B.method: Step parameters: averages for each dimer step in protein-DNA crystal complexes (Olson et al. 1998, Table 1). Base-pair parameters: medians over high-resolution B-DNA crystal duplexes in the PDB. Nucleotide geometry: 3DNA's B-DNA set (Arnott backbone, chi -110 deg).
sources: Olson et al., DNA sequence-dependent deformability deduced from protein-DNA crystal complexes, PNAS 95, 11163 (1998)
Olson et al., A standard reference frame for the description of nucleic acid base-pair geometry, J. Mol. Biol. 313, 229 (2001)

A.method: Uniform step and base-pair parameters: medians over 17 high-resolution A-DNA crystal duplexes in the PDB. Nucleotide geometry: 3DNA's A-DNA set (chi -160 deg).

Z.method: Alternating CG and GC step parameters and base-pair parameters: medians over 33 high-resolution Z-DNA crystal duplexes in the PDB; nucleotides (syn G, anti C) from the same crystals.
sources: Wang et al., Molecular structure of a left-handed double helical DNA fragment at atomic resolution, Nature 282, 680 (1979)
